meta.title: WasteLoop — surplus food and organic waste exchange
meta.description: WasteLoop connects people with surplus food and organic waste to farmers, energy plants, recyclers and charities who can use it.

footer.tagline: Keeping food and organic waste in the loop.
footer.platformNotice: WasteLoop is a connection and coordination platform only. It does not operate vehicles, hold funds, certify food safety or process waste.

hero.title: Your surplus is someone else's resource.
hero.subtitle: Restaurants, shops, caterers and households post what they have left over. Farmers, energy plants, recyclers and charities pick it up.

streams.title: Four streams, one place
streams.subtitle: Every listing belongs to one stream, so it reaches the people who can actually use it.

edible_food.body: Cooked meals, bread, produce and packaged food that is still good to eat.
edible_food.takers: Taken by charities and community kitchens

organic_compostable.body: Peels, trimmings, spoiled produce and garden waste.
organic_compostable.takers: Taken by farmers for compost and animal feed

plastic_recyclable.body: Clean food packaging, bottles and containers.
plastic_recyclable.takers: Taken by recyclers and scrap buyers

energy_feedstock.body: Used cooking oil and bulk organic waste for biogas.

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: Say what it is, where it is, and when it can be collected. It takes under a minute.
how.step2Body: Nearby takers see your listing and send a request. You choose who to accept.
how.step3Body: Agree a pickup time in the chat, meet, and both confirm the handover.

notice.title: What WasteLoop does, and what it doesn't
notice.body: We connect people and help them coordinate. We do not collect, transport, buy, certify or process anything. The two parties arrange the handover themselves.

landing.deactivatedNotice: Your account has been deactivated. Log in again at any time to reactivate it.

foodSafety.notice: WasteLoop does not certify food safety. Check the condition of the food in person before you accept it.

roleDescriptions.energy_plant: I turn organic waste or used oil into energy

login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Welcome back to WasteLoop.
login.linkExpired: That link has expired or was already used. Please log in, or request a new link.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Free for everyone. It takes about a minute.
register.orgNameHint: Shown on your listings, for example “Shapla Restaurant”.
register.phoneHint: Only shared with people you exchange with.
register.rolesHint: Choose all that apply. You can change this later.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your e-mail and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a reset link is on its way. It expires in one hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: You will stay signed in on this device.
reset.expiredTitle: This reset link is no longer valid
reset.expiredBody: Reset links work once and expire after an hour. Request a new one to continue.

impact.title: Your impact
impact.none: Your impact appears here after your first completed handover.

dashboard.completeProfile: Add your area in settings so we can show listings near you first.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Other people see your name, organisation, area and bio. Your phone number is shared only with people you exchange with.
profile.emailHint: Your sign-in address. It is never shown publicly.
profile.bioHint: A sentence or two about what you offer or collect.
profile.generalLocationHint: Neighbourhood and city, for example “Mirpur, Dhaka”. Never your exact address.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Your roles decide what you can do: providers post listings, takers send requests.

account.title: Deactivate account
account.description: Deactivating hides your profile, pauses your listings and withdraws your pending requests. Log in again at any time to reactivate.
account.dialogBody: Your live listings will be paused and your pending requests withdrawn. Exchanges already accepted are not cancelled.
account.requestRemoval: Also ask for my personal data to be deleted
account.requestRemovalHint: An administrator will erase your account and personal data. This cannot be undone.
